title: Scene Describe Run
description: Async scene describe-run status payload. Submitted via POST /scene/describe/run as multipart/form-data: form fields 'tenant_id' (uuid), 'media_ids' (JSON int array), and optional 'recognition_enabled' (boolean, default true). Plus one file part 'image_<media_id>' (raw bytes) per media id. When recognition_enabled is false, the run writes alt text without identity fusion.

eta_seconds.description: Estimated seconds remaining; null unless the run is in-flight with measured progress.

gpu_state.description: Burst-GPU execution state read from the lifecycle snapshot /run/acx/gpu-state.json (single writer: infra.oci.gpu_lifecycle). 'unknown' when the snapshot is missing, unreadable, or stale — never fabricated as ready. See docs/workbay/contracts/gpu-lifecycle.md § GPU state snapshot.

recognition_enabled.description: Snapshot of WP acx_recognition_enabled at submit. When false, Describe writes alt text without identities. Defaults to true when omitted on submit.
